thesis: This episode argues that the most durable US technology companies possess massive distribution and infrastructure advantages that allow them to fund continued innovation, while also noting that incumbents like Salesforce face specific workflow reimagination risks. It suggests that the next five years may offer 5X upside rather than 10X, but that early-stage investments often come from teams with pre-existing relationships to the firm.
